description: A window function may appear NESTED inside a larger expression - revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (...), 100 * RATIO_TO_REPORT(x) OVER (...), or as an argument to another function - not only as a whole SELECT item. This previously threw 'window function (OVER) not ported', because the surrounding expression was AST-evaluated without the window path being triggered. Pinned with the window on the right of a subtraction, under a multiplication, inside a function call, and as a whole select item, which is the regression guard for the shape that already worked. Converted 1:1 from query/WindowInExpressionTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE sales (yr NUMBER, revenue NUMBER)
SELECT yr, revenue - LAG(revenue, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS diff FROM sales ORDER BY yr
CREATE TABLE sales (yr NUMBER, revenue NUMBER)
SELECT yr, 100 * RATIO_TO_REPORT(revenue) OVER () AS pct FROM sales ORDER BY yr
CREATE TABLE sales (yr NUMBER, revenue NUMBER)
SELECT yr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS rn FROM sales ORDER BY yr
CREATE TABLE sales (yr NUMBER, revenue NUMBER)
SELECT yr, ABS(LAG(revenue, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY yr) - revenue) AS d FROM sales ORDER BY yr
